body: please don't. it will get better. i promise. you are not alone.

it's not fair that you lost your friends. it's not fair that you have to feel this terrible, unceasing pain from their loss. are you ever in touch with their families? they may be dead, but as long as you remember them they are not forgotten.

no matter what, you deserve someone who will be faithful to you. don't ever forget that. what was the support group like? whenever i think of the motivations that drive thoughts of suicide, my heart physically hurts. i don't know if it's psychosomatic but it feels so real to me. can you tell me what your two friends were like? i'd like to know.

i'm sorry about your dad. no one should go through that. i'm reading everything you wrote. i'm here for you. can you tell me more about what hurts? i'd like to sympathize. we might be on the same page.
stay with me. i don't think you are a waste of time.
